description: This file defines the MacroScreenRenderer class, which implements rendering of screens using FreeMarker macros within the OFBiz framework. It manages rendering lifecycle methods, section handling, container management, links, images, content blocks, screenlets, portal pages, columns, and portlets, mainly through macro execution and template inclusion.

classes.name: MacroScreenRenderer
classes.description: Implementation of ScreenStringRenderer, managing macros-based screen rendering within OFBiz, including sections, containers, links, content, screenlets, portal pages, columns, portlets, and macro execution control.

methods.name: getRendererName
methods.description: Returns the name of this renderer.

methods.name: renderBegin
methods.description: Executes the 'renderBegin' macro to mark the start of rendering.

methods.name: renderEnd
methods.description: Executes the 'renderEnd' macro to mark the end of rendering.

methods.name: renderScreenBegin
methods.description: Pushes the current screen onto the stack and executes macro to render the beginning of a screen.

methods.name: renderScreenEnd
methods.description: Drops the screen from the stack and executes macro to render the end of a screen.

methods.name: renderSectionBegin
methods.description: Conditionally executes macro to mark the beginning of a section, with optional named border rendering.

methods.name: renderSectionEnd
methods.description: Conditionally executes macro to mark the end of a section, with optional named border rendering.

methods.name: renderContainerBegin
methods.description: Executes macro to render the beginning of a container, managing auto-update links.

methods.name: renderContainerEnd
methods.description: Executes macro to close the container.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Executes macro to render a label widget.

methods.name: renderHorizontalSeparator
methods.description: Executes macro to render a horizontal separator widget.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Constructs parameters and executes macro to render a link widget, including handling images.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Constructs the image URL based on URL mode and executes macro to render an image widget.

methods.name: renderContentBegin
methods.description: Executes macro for starting content section with editing options.

methods.name: renderContentBody
methods.description: Renders content blocks, including embedded content or data resources, with handling for errors.

methods.name: renderContentEnd
methods.description: Executes macro to close content blocks, with optional edit links.

methods.name: renderContentFrame
methods.description: Constructs URL for a content frame view and calls macro to render the frame.

methods.name: renderSubContentBegin
methods.description: Executes macro to begin subcontent area with editing options.

methods.name: renderSubContentBody
methods.description: Renders sub-content, possibly embedded, with error handling.

methods.name: renderSubContentEnd
methods.description: Executes macro to close subcontent area, providing edit links if applicable.

methods.name: renderScreenletBegin
methods.description: Renders a screenlet start, managing collapse state, menus, and styling.

methods.name: renderScreenletSubWidget
methods.description: Renders sub-widgets within a screenlet, substituting the form renderer for navigation forms.

methods.name: renderScreenletEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a screenlet rendering.

methods.name: renderScreenletPaginateMenu
methods.description: Builds and executes pagination controls for screenlets.

methods.name: renderPortalPageBegin
methods.description: Executes macro to render beginning of a portal page with labels and UI hints.

methods.name: renderPortalPageEnd
methods.description: Executes macro marking the end of a portal page.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnBegin
methods.description: Builds macro parameters for a column and executes macro to render it.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnEnd
methods.description: Marks end of a column via macro.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBegin
methods.description: Builds parameters and executes macro to start rendering a portlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletEnd
methods.description: Marks end of portlet rendering.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBody
methods.description: Loads and renders the screen associated with a portlet.

methods.name: renderColumnContainer
methods.description: Renders a column container and its subcolumns/subwidgets.

methods.name: getFoStyle
methods.description: Utility to fetch style property for a given style name.
